title: Autonomous Quantum Measurement with Agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.38850v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantum materials exhibit diverse electronic and functional phenomena, but their characterization requires extensive experimental expertise, iterative decision-making and accumulated laboratory knowledge that is difficult to document and transfer. Here we introduce Quantum Agent (QUANTA), an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for autonomous quantum-materials characterization. Using a widely adopted Physical Property Measurement System (PPMS) as an experimental platform, QUANTA combines retrieval augmentation using scientific literature, experimental protocols and prior measurements with specialized agents for experimental planning, troubleshooting, and data interpretation. A separate deterministic control layer validates instrument actions. Guided by incoming data, QUANTA evaluates measurement quality, revises experimental plans and selects subsequent measurements. We demonstrate these capabilities through transport measure

translated_title: 基于智能体人工智能的自主量子测量
translated_abstract: 量子材料展现出多样的电子与功能现象，但其表征需要大量的实验专业知识、反复迭代的决策以及难以记录和传承的实验室经验积累。在此，我们介绍量子智能体（QUANTA），一个用于自主量子材料表征的智能体人工智能（AI）框架。QUANTA以广泛使用的物性测量系统（PPMS）作为实验平台，将基于科学文献、实验方案和历史测量数据的检索增强技术与专门负责实验规划、故障排除和数据解读的专用智能体相结合，并由一个独立的确定性控制层对仪器操作进行验证。在传入数据的引导下，QUANTA能够评估测量质量、修改实验计划并选择后续测量。我们通过输运测量演示了这些能力……
tldr: 该论文提出了QUANTA——一个智能体AI框架，它结合科学文献检索增强与实验规划、故障排除、数据解读等专用智能体，能在物性测量系统（PPMS）上自主完成量子材料表征的规划、执行与解释。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces QUANTA, an agentic AI framework that combines literature-based retrieval augmentation with specialized planning, troubleshooting, and data-interpretation agents to autonomously conduct quantum materials characterization measurements on a PPMS.
